description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to wireless network configuration, including functions for validating WPS pins, updating WiFi settings, managing MAC filters, and other wireless configuration actions in a network device management interface.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS PIN to ensure it's correctly formatted and passes checksum validation.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Checks if the filter parameters are valid by verifying printable characters and MAC address format for each entry.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies configuration changes to a specific SSID by triggering the setting application process.
